title: Godot 4 texture import presets (.import sidecars, materials, project settings)
summary: Writes Godot 4 .import sidecars, StandardMaterial3D .tres and project.godot settings for pixel-art versus smooth, 3D, normal-map and UI textures, and checks existing imports.
description: Option names and enum values were taken from Godot's own sources (ResourceImporterTexture, BaseMaterial3D.TextureFilter/Transparency, Viewport.DefaultCanvasItemTextureFilter); the official 2D platformer demo uses the same default_texture_filter=0 and integer stretch scaling.
